post.text:
This experiment breaks your brain 🤯 

Remove air in the world’s largest vacuum chamber, drop a bowling ball and feathers, and Galileo is proven right—400 years later.

**@astraterra_**  
Galileo's groundbreaking assertion was that in the absence of air resistance, all objects, regardless of their mass, fall at the same rate.  
This was a revolutionary idea, challenging the then-prevailing Aristotelian view. In the vast vacuum chamber, when air resistance is removed, the bowling ball and feathers fall simultaneously, visually confirming Galileo's insight. This experiment not only pays homage to a foundational moment in physics but also underscores the enduring power of curiosity and the scientific method.
